sloka: तस्माद्दण्डे महाबाहो यत्नवान्भव पुत्रक ।धर्मो हि परमो लोके कुर्वतस्ते भविष्यति ।। ७.७९.१० ॥
transliteration: tasmāddaṇḍe mahābāho yatnavānbhava putraka ।dharmo hi paramo loke kurvataste bhaviṣyati ।। 7.79.10 ॥

translations.english: Therefore, O mighty-armed son, be diligent in administering justice, for by doing so, supreme righteousness will be yours in this world.
